x: A new monthly periodical is now issued entitled "Athletics." This is being sponsored by our old R.A.F. friend, Jimmy Green, of Gillingham fame. Subscription is 7/- per annum direct from P.

The new monthly magazine, Athletics, is now well established and needs no introduction to most members. For those not acquainted with Athletics, it is published by John Langdon Ltd., 40 Maida Vale, W.9, and is edited by one of our members, P.
Members attention is called to the interesting and informative periodical " Athletics Weekly " at 6d. per copy, edited by P.
